title: SSLib v2.0 Protocol
author: Alicia Grealy
materials: Ensure ice is available. Thaw reagents on ice as needed. Keep enzymes on ice at all times. Do not vortex enzymes to mix but mix by flicking the tube gently. Pulse centrifuge all reagents before opening.

Prepare all necessary buffers and UV decontaminate where appropriate. Only add the SDS to the Bead Binding Buffer right before us. Discard Bead Binding Buffer after use. Aliquot 5X SYBR into 500-ul batches and store at -20 deg C in foil. Aliquot dNTPs into 50-ul batches and store at -20 deg C. steps.title: Prepare Workspace and PPE
steps.instruction: Set up the reaction in a reagent-only pre-PCR space within a dedicated ultraclean environment. Decontaminate surfaces with 10% household bleach followed by 70% ethanol, and UV irradiate pipettes and racks.

substeps.instruction: Suit up in order: hair net, nitrile gloves, facemask, coveralls, gumboots, booties, and a second pair of gloves.
Bleach racks between subsequent uses and UV irradiate.

steps.title: Prepare Oligo Working Stocks
steps.instruction: Prepare and store oligo working concentrations at -20°C. Ensure oligos and adapters are stored in a separate box from enzymes or reagents.

substeps.instruction: Pulse centrifuge oligos to collect the pellet.
Add appropriate buffer and vortex thoroughly.
Thaw on ice, vortex, and pulse centrifuge after each thaw.
Dilute standards in a separate space (e.g., teaching lab) to prevent contamination.

steps.title: Prepare DS1 (CL78/Splinter)
steps.instruction: Combine reagents in a 0.2 ml Lo-bind PCR tube, vortex, and pulse centrifuge to create 10/20 uM of CL78/Splinter (DS1).

substeps.instruction: Incubate for 10 sec at 95°C.
Ramp down to 10°C at 0.1°C/sec in a thermal cycler with a heated lid.

steps.title: Prepare DS2 (CL53/CL73)
steps.instruction: Combine reagents in a 0.2 ml Lo-bind PCR tube, vortex, and pulse centrifuge to create 200 uM of CL53/CL73 (DS2).

substeps.instruction: Add 50 ul of TE buffer to DS2 to make 100 uM of DS2.

steps.title: Prepare Ligation Master Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare the master mix in a 1.5 ml Lo-bind tube, vortex, and pulse centrifuge.

substeps.instruction: Aliquot 34 ul of master mix per reaction into 0.2 ml Lo-bind PCR tubes.

steps.title: Add DNA and Finalize Reaction Volume
steps.instruction: Bring the total reaction volume to 46 ul for each sample.

substeps.instruction: For sample reactions: Add up to 12 ul DNA (typically 3x10^8 - 3x10^11 ds molecules; 1 fmol-1pmol ssDNA; 13 pg-14 ng of ~40 bp DNA) and make up the remainder with Ultrapure water.
For positive control: Add 1 ul of 0.1 uM CL104 positive control oligo (3.01x10^10 molecules) and 11 ul Ultrapure water.
For no-template control: Add 12 ul of Ultrapure water.

steps.title: Perform First Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate reactions in a thermal cycler with a heated lid.

substeps.instruction: Incubate for 10 min at 37°C.
Incubate for 2 min at 95°C.
Place immediately into an ice water bath.

steps.title: Perform Second Incubation
steps.instruction: Prepare a second master mix in a 1.5 ml Lo-bind tube, vortex, and pulse centrifuge.

substeps.instruction: Aliquot 34.4 ul of this mix to the reactions from the previous step; vortex and pulse centrifuge.
Incubate 1 hr at 37°C in a thermal cycler, followed by 1 min at 95°C.
Transfer immediately to ice.

steps.title: Prepare Streptavidin Beads
steps.instruction: Prepare MyOne C1 Streptavidin beads, allowing them to reach room temperature and vortexing.

substeps.instruction: Aliquot 20 ul of beads per sample (including controls) into 1.5 ml Lo-bind tubes, adding 20 ul extra for pipetting error.
Separate beads on a magnetic rack for 1-2 minutes and discard supernatant.
Add 500 ul of Bead Binding Buffer (ensure SDS is added directly before use) and vortex.
Repeat the magnetic separation and discard supernatant.
Resuspend beads in 250 ul Bead Binding Buffer per sample (including controls/error) by pipetting gently.
Aliquot 250 ul of bead suspension into new 1.5 ml Lo-bind Safelock tubes (1 per sample + controls).

steps.title: Ligate DNA to Beads
steps.instruction: Combine the ligation reactions with the bead suspension.

substeps.instruction: If reactions were frozen at -20°C: Incubate for 1 min at 95°C and transfer to ice water bath for 2-5 min.
Add ligation reactions to the bead suspension and vortex.
Incubate for 20 min at room temperature with inversion (or use rotating hybridization oven/nutator/rocker).
Pulse centrifuge and pellet beads with a magnetic rack; discard supernatant.

steps.title: Perform First Wash Sequence
steps.instruction: Wash the beads to remove reagents.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 ul Wash A, vortex, pulse centrifuge, pellet with magnetic rack, and discard supernatant.
Add 100 ul Stringency Wash Buffer, vortex, and incubate 3 min at 45°C (vortexing every 30 sec). Pulse centrifuge, pellet with magnetic rack, and discard supernatant.

steps.title: Perform Second Wash and Denaturation
steps.instruction: Complete the wash and denature the DNA.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 ul Wash B, vortex, pulse centrifuge, pellet with magnetic rack, and discard supernatant.
Prepare a master mix in a 1.5 ml Lo-bind tube, vortex, and pulse centrifuge.
Add 48 ul of master mix to each reaction, vortex, and pulse centrifuge.
Incubate 2 min at 65°C in a heat block/thermal shaker, then place immediately in ice water bath for 2-5 min.
Transfer rack to room temperature.

steps.title: Perform Klenow Extension
steps.instruction: Extend the DNA using Klenow fragment.

substeps.instruction: Add 2 ul of Klenow fragment (10 U/ul) to reactions, vortex, and pulse centrifuge.
Incubate 5 min at 25°C (or room temperature), followed by 25 min at 35°C in a thermo shaker (shaking at 1000 rpm).

steps.title: Perform Second Wash Sequence
steps.instruction: Wash the beads after extension.

substeps.instruction: Pellet beads on a magnetic rack and discard supernatant.
Add 200 ul Wash A, vortex, pulse centrifuge, pellet with magnetic rack, and discard supernatant.
Add 100 ul Stringency Wash Buffer, vortex, and incubate 3 min at 45°C (vortexing every 30 sec). Pulse centrifuge, pellet with magnetic rack, and discard supernatant.
Add 200 ul Wash B, vortex, pulse centrifuge, pellet with magnetic rack, and discard supernatant.

steps.title: Perform Final Extension and Elution
steps.instruction: Perform final extension and elute the libraries.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a master mix in a 1.5 ml Lo-bind tube, vortex, and pulse centrifuge.
Add 100 ul of master mix to each tube, vortex, and pulse centrifuge.
Incubate 1 hr at 22°C in thermo shaker (shaking at 1000 rpm).
Pellet beads in a magnetic rack and discard supernatant.
Add 200 ul Wash A, vortex, pulse centrifuge, pellet with magnetic rack, and discard supernatant.
Add 100 ul Stringency Wash Buffer, vortex, and incubate 3 min at 45°C (vortexing every 30 sec). Pulse centrifuge, pellet with magnetic rack, and discard supernatant.
Add 200 ul Wash B, vortex, pulse centrifuge, pellet with magnetic rack, and discard supernatant.
Add 25 ul EBT buffer, vortex, and pulse centrifuge.
Incubate 2 min at 95°C in a thermo shaker (without shaking).
Immediately pellet beads on a magnetic rack and transfer supernatant to a clean 0.5 ml Lo-bind tube.

steps.title: Perform Assay A qPCR
steps.instruction: Quantify the libraries using qPCR.

substeps.instruction: Prepare two separate master mixes in 1.5 ml Lo-bind tubes, vortex, and pulse centrifuge.
Add 1 ul of DNA sample to corresponding PCR tubes and pulse centrifuge.
Add 24 ul of master mix to tubes and pulse centrifuge.
Create a 1:20 dilution of each library (1 ul library + 19 ul Ultrapure water), vortex, and pulse centrifuge.
Run PCR program: 95°C for 10 min, followed by 50 cycles of (95°C for 30 sec, 60°C for 30 sec, 72°C for 30 sec).
Electrophorese 10 ul of PCR product (libraries and controls) on a 2% agarose gel.

steps.title: Perform Indexing PCR
steps.instruction: Add indices to the libraries via PCR.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a master mix in a 1.5 ml Lo-bind tube (enough for 4 reactions per library), vortex, and pulse centrifuge.
Add 19 ul of master mix to corresponding PCR tubes and pulse centrifuge.
Add 0.5 ul of the corresponding forward indexing primer and 0.5 ul of the corresponding reverse indexing primer to each tube; pulse centrifuge.
Add 5 ul of DNA sample to each reaction and pulse centrifuge.
Run PCR program: 95°C for 10 min, followed by a determined number of cycles (based on Assay A) of (95°C for 30 sec, 60°C for 30 sec, 72°C for 30 sec).
Pulse centrifuge, combine replicate PCR reactions into a 1.5 ml Lo-bind Safelock tube, vortex, and pulse centrifuge.

steps.title: Purify and Quantify Libraries
steps.instruction: Purify the indexed libraries and measure molarity.

substeps.instruction: Purify libraries using SeraMag Speed/Select beads at 1.6X bead:reaction volume; elute in 35 ul Ultrapure water.
Dilute libraries 1:10 in Ultrapure water (1 ul library in 9 ul water).
Measure molarity (160-500 bp) using LabChip GXII or equivalent.

steps.title: Pool and Size-Select Libraries
steps.instruction: Pool libraries and select for the desired fragment size.

substeps.instruction: Pool libraries in equimolar concentrations (total DNA per library ≤ 500-1000 ng).
Run each pool in duplicate (20 ul each) on a PippinHT system (2% gel, Marker 20B), selecting fragments between 160-500 bp.
Combine replicates and purify using SeraMag Speed/Select beads at 2X bead:reaction volume; elute in 25 ul Ultrapure water.

steps.title: Final Library Quantification
steps.instruction: Perform final concentration and molarity checks.

substeps.instruction: Create serial dilutions of libraries (1/2, 1/5, 1/10) in 10 ul volumes of Ultrapure water.
Measure concentration of neat and diluted libraries in duplicate using Qubit.
Measure molarity of neat and diluted libraries using LabChip GXII Hisense kit.
Calculate molarity based on average fragment length and Qubit measurements; extrapolate neat concentration from linear dilution curve.

steps.title: Prepare for Sequencing
steps.instruction: Dilute the library and perform the sequencing run.

substeps.instruction: Dilute library to 2-4 nM in Ultrapure water.
Spike in CL72_custom_sequencing_primer (well 12 or 18). For NextSeq, also add custom i5_indexing_primer.
Perform sequencing run following manufacturer's instructions.
